movelist.name: Sing
movelist.effect: All legal Targets fall Asleep. On a miss, Sing instead causes targets to become Slowed and suffer a -2 penalty to their Evasion until the end of the user’s next turn.

movelist.name: Fury Cutter
movelist.effect: If Fury Cutter is used successfully and consecutively on the same target, the Damage Base is increased by +4 to a maximum of 16. For example, the first hit would have a DB of 4; the second hit a DB of 8; the third hit a DB of 12; the fourth and further hits a DB of 16. If Fury Cuter misses or fails to damage its target, its Damage Base resets.

movelist.name: Leech Life
movelist.effect: After the target takes damage, the user gains HP equal to half of the damage they dealt to the target.

abilities.name: Rally
abilities.effect: The user and all allies within 10 meters may immediately Disengage 1 Meter as a free Action. Rally does not work on sleeping, paralyzed, stuck, fainted, or otherwise incapacitated allies.

abilities.name: Confidence
abilities.effect: Choose a Combat Stat. All allies within 5 meters of the user gain +1 CS in the Chosen Stat.
